cases.title: Inbox with existing conversations but no IMAP-configured mailbox still shows the conversations (not only the IMAP setup guide)
Unified Inbox lists both conversations (unread highlighted) with subject/snippet; no problems
Search narrows the list; opening a thread shows the message and marks it read (DB is_unread=0)
Reply form: empty reply does nothing; Enter sends a reply -> OUTBOUND message stored for that conversation
Reply failure (API 500) restores the draft text and does not crash
Sync button without IMAP reports a clear message; Refresh works
Tenant isolation: conversations of this workspace are not visible to another workspace
Domain Health lists the workspace sending domain with SPF/DKIM/DMARC chips, KPIs consistent with inbox count
Trend filter select: switching All domains <-> single domain re-renders the chart without errors
Details modal shows DNS/campaign/inbox info; Run Diagnostics gives feedback; Close works
Delete domain: confirm, removes the domain card and DB record (no add-domain UI exists: domains derive from inboxes)
AGENT role can open Domain Health without forbidden-API noise
